extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A satellite image dataset for land use and land cover classification based on Sentinel-2 imagery. It consists of 27,000 labeled, geo-referenced images across 10 classes and covers 13 spectral bands.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images from Sentinel-2A were downloaded via Amazon S3 for cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries. Images with low cloud levels were selected, and from the obtained satellite images the authors created 27,000 georeferenced, labeled 64x64 image patches that were manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral Sentinel-2A satellite imagery of European cities, covering 13 spectral bands, downloaded from Amazon S3.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Images were recorded all over the year.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Image patches were labeled using the European Urban Atlas mapping guide and manually checked; the dataset consists of 10 classes with 27,000 geo-referenced labeled image patches.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The trained classifier uses 64x64 image patches and therefore does not support fine-grained per-pixel segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may support socially relevant applications such as urban development, nature protection, sustainable development, climate-change monitoring, detecting illegal forest clearing, and improving crowdsourced maps.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geographic location information through geo-referenced satellite images.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended as training data for deep neural networks for satellite image classification and for real-world Earth observation applications including land use/land cover classification, change detection, and assisting map updating.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is publicly released on GitHub, but no update schedule, maintainer details, or deprecation policy are specified.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Selected satellite images with low cloud coverage, extracted 64x64 georeferenced image patches, and manually checked the patches.
